notes: First observing run of LIDA laser-interferometric axion detector (85 h). Peak sensitivity g_agamma = 1.51e-10 GeV^-1 at m_a = 1.985 neV (480.0 kHz), average 3.2e-10 GeV^-1 over 1.97-2.01 neV, all at 95% CL. This is a galactic-halo DM search assuming the standard coherent axion field (rho_DM appears in signal model) but the paper does not state the numerical local DM density value, so dm_density_assumed is left null. Full sensitivity curve is only in Fig. 2; emitted points reconstruct the band from explicit numbers in the text (peak plus average as band endpoints), so the shape is approximate. Future projections (1e-13 GeV^-1 at 1e-14 eV) mentioned but not the primary result. | selector: text (sole candidate)
